name: show_plans_and_credits
description: Open the single combined pricing widget for everything billing-related. The widget has two tabs the user can switch between: **Upgrade Plan** (Plus + Ultra, monthly + annual subscription cards) and **Top-up Credits** (one-time credit packs of 500 / 1,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 credits). Cards include feature lists, 7-Day Unlimited highlights, and 365-Day Unlimited blocks pulled from the live pricing config. Each plan card and credit pack has a CTA that links directly to the relevant Stripe or Higgsfield checkout/setup URL — no separate tool is needed to mint checkouts. For every billing request, the text response and `assistant_response` are intentionally short, user-facing sales copy with checkout URLs wrapped as action-specific Markdown links such as `[Go to Checkout](url)`, `[Higgsfield Upgrade](url)`, `[Higgsfield Credit Top-up](url)`, `[Higgsfield Auto-refill](url)`, `[Higgsfield Team Top-up](url)`, or `[Higgsfield Team Auto-refill](url)`; relay that response verbatim instead of summarizing, saying only that the widget opened, or listing options without links. If the user asks to buy credits or they are out of credits, first push auto-refill when `auto_refill_purchase_link` is present, then show `credit_purchase_links`. If the user asks to upgrade or a minimum plan is required, show `plan_purchase_links`. Pass `intent='auto_refill'` for out-of-credits recovery, `intent='topup'` for one-time credit packs, `intent='upgrade'` for plan upgrades, or `intent='trial'` when the user specifically asks for the free trial so the response is ordered for that purchase path. FREE TRIAL: when `free_trial` is present in the response, the user is eligible for a 3-day $0 Plus trial with MCP-only credits — the widget shows it and the text response leads with it. In text-only clients ALWAYS relay `free_trial.compliance_note` verbatim (MCP-only, card required, automatic charge after the trial unless cancelled, how to cancel by saying 'cancel auto-renewal'). When `free_trial` is absent, NEVER speculate about trial eligibility or mention fraud/abuse checks — present the paid plans neutrally. When `initial_view='trial_upgrade'`, the user's trial credits are exhausted: relay the numbered upgrade options plus the renewal reminder, and mention that saying 'cancel auto-renewal' stops the upcoming charge while keeping trial access. To cancel the trial's auto-renewal, call `cancel_trial_auto_renewal` instead of this tool. Use this tool for ANY of these requests: plans, pricing, subscriptions, upgrade options, comparing tiers, buying credits, topping up credits, refilling credits, credit packs. Do not look for separate `show_plans` or `show_credit_topups` tools — both have been merged into this one. Returns `already_subscribed: true` when the workspace is already on a paid plan; the widget hides the Upgrade tab in that case and shows only credit top-ups. Team-plan workspaces: `workspace_kind` field indicates the context. When `workspace_kind='team_owner'`, the widget renders team-specific Top-up and Auto-refill UIs and emits `team_purchase_links` (two links: `team_top_up` and `team_auto_refill`) that deeplink to the team billing modals on higgsfield.ai — relay both Markdown links in the text response. When `workspace_kind='team_member'`, no purchase links are returned; the widget shows a read-only notice and the text response tells the user only the workspace owner can buy credits or change auto-refill. Do not invent purchase links for members.

intent.description: Purchase path to prioritize in the widget and text fallback. Use auto_refill for out-of-credits recovery, topup for one-time credit packs, upgrade for minimum-plan errors or plan changes, trial when the user specifically asks for the free trial, and general for pricing comparison.

plans.description: Subscription plan cards with rich pricing-config data merged in. Empty when the user is on a paid plan.

currency.description: ISO currency code (usd/eur/gbp) for all *_cents fields; absent means USD. Amounts are numerically identical across currencies.

trial_checklist.description: Feature checklist rows for the trial-flow plan cards, derived from the pricing config (GET /mcp/pricing per-plan mainFeatures; legacy plan keys resolved via plus↔ultimate / ultra↔creator aliases). Never empty: static design rows are substituted when the config can't supply them.

status.description: included renders a checkmark, excluded a cross.

accent.description: Row rendered with the cyan Supercomputer brand mark and text tint.

badge.description: Right-aligned lime chip label, e.g. '60% cheaper'.

trial_checklist_static.description: Marker: trial_checklist rows are the STATIC design fallback (pricing config unavailable / plan missing / no features), not pricing-config data.

topups.description: One-time credit top-up packages. Empty when the user is on the free plan.

display_price_cents.description: Clean rounded display price in cents for card UI. When null, fall back to creator-display-price constant (creator plan) or price_cents.

currency.description: ISO currency code (usd/eur/gbp) for the *_cents fields; absent means USD.

topup_expire_days.description: Number of days extra credits remain valid after purchase.

already_subscribed.description: True if the workspace already has a paid plan.

current_plan.description: Plan type the workspace is currently on, when already_subscribed=true.

auto_top_up_setup_url.description: Checkout/setup URL for credits auto-refill. Render the setup banner only when this URL is present.

top_annual_discount_percent.description: Largest annual discount percentage to show near the annual billing toggle.

initial_tab.description: Tab the widget should select first for this tool invocation.

auto_refill.description: Credits auto-refill settings. Drives the auto-refill subtab inside the top-up panel; only shown when is_eligible=true.

currency.description: ISO currency code (usd/eur/gbp) for the money amounts (options, current_refill_amount, outstanding_amount); absent means USD.

promotional_text.description: Short promoter-style copy suitable for text-only MCP clients.

purchase_links.description: Flattened direct purchase/setup links. Agents MUST relay relevant URLs when the client does not render the billing widget.

free_trial.description: 3-day free Plus trial offer. Present ⇔ the user is eligible. When absent, do NOT speculate about why — keep copy neutral (never mention eligibility, fraud, or abuse checks).

billing_period.description: Billing period of the post-trial subscription.

trial_credits.description: MCP-only credits granted for the trial.

then_price_cents.description: Price auto-charged to the saved card after the trial unless cancelled.

currency.description: ISO currency code (usd/eur/gbp) for then_price_cents; absent means USD.

checkout_url.description: Hosted $0 checkout URL (card required). Relay this exact link in text-only clients.

headline.description: Trial card title, e.g. '3-Day Free Plus Trial'.

credit_equivalents.description: STATIC marketing approximations ('= 50 Nano Banana Pro images'), not API data.

price_line.description: e.g. '$0 for 3 days, then renews at $49/mo'.

renewal_caption.description: Caption under the CTA, e.g. 'Renews to Plus ($49/mo) after 3-day trial'.

compliance_note.description: Full trial disclosures: MCP-only, credits never appear on higgsfield.ai, auto-charge after the trial unless cancelled, how to cancel, exclusions. Always relay in text-only clients.

trial_status.description: Current MCP free-trial state, when the status endpoint responded.

eligible.description: True when the user can still start the trial.

status.description: Trial lifecycle state, e.g. 'active'. Null when the user never interacted with the trial.

trial_ends_at.description: ISO timestamp when the trial ends / the saved card is auto-charged.

trial_credits.description: Remaining MCP-only trial credits. Null when no trial was ever started.

initial_view.description: Layout the widget opens with: plans (Plus/Ultra grid, plus the trial section when free_trial is present), trial (standalone trial card), trial_upgrade (trial credits exhausted — upgrade view).

plan_comparison.description: STATIC Free/Plus/Ultra comparison table for the trial-exhausted view.

recommended_plan.description: Column visually highlighted in the widget.

rows.description: true renders as a checkmark, false as a dash, strings verbatim.

static_content.description: Marker: rows are hardcoded marketing content mirroring the approved designs, NOT served by the pricing API.

trial_purchase_link.description: Direct $0 trial checkout link, when the user is eligible.
